text:
Tammy: Heads up — Diego handed in his resignation earlier today. Last official day is 2026-10-15. I need us to confirm benefits end date, COBRA timeline, asset return, and who owns removing cloud access.

Maria: Thanks Tammy — I'll handle benefits/COBRA. Per our policy benefits run through the end of the termination month unless otherwise noted. That means coverage through 2026-10-31. COBRA packet will be triggered once benefits are terminated; BenefitCo will send the election notice on 2026-11-01 and Diego will have 60 days to elect. I'll email him and cc benefits@. :email:

Ashwin: On IT side — we'll schedule deprovisioning. Need Okta username, laptop serial, list of service accounts keys that Diego owns, and whether he has standing prod DB creds.

Tammy: Okta: diego@redwood.com. Laptop serial: AB1234567. He has access to gke-redwood, s3-redwood, and the analytics-prod service account (analytics-sa@). Not sure about DB direct user — Ben?

Ben: He does have a DB role on analytics-prod (readonly + some write jobs). Recommend rotating the DB user password and revoking any personal keys on 2026-10-16 (day after last day) to avoid disrupting running batch jobs. Also remove his SSH public keys from bastion hosts when deprovisioning.

Tammy: Good call. Rebecca — can you coordinate laptop pickup/return? We'll include UPS label if they prefer drop-off.

Rebecca: I can pick up on 2026-10-17 morning (on-site). I'll send Diego the asset return checklist and a prepaid label. Will note the serial and IMEI for inventory.

it-bot: Created IT ticket IT-4629: "Deprovision diego@redwood.com & asset return" — assigned to Ashwin. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-4629 :robot_face:

Ashwin: Plan I propose: 2026-10-16 10:00am PT — disable Okta account and revoke active sessions; 2026-10-16 11:00am PT — remove service account keys, rotate any machine credentials Diego owned, remove IAM bindings for analytics-sa; 2026-10-17 09:00am PT — confirm SSH key removals and close IT-4629. Will post status updates in the ticket.

Ben: For DB rotation I'll open DB-0784 and schedule a rolling password change so batch jobs aren't interrupted. Post-rotation we'll verify jobs on 10/16 afternoon.

Tammy: Exit interview — Diego said he'd prefer a quick 30-min call. Can we do 2026-10-14 at 3:00pm PT? If not, 2026-10-15 11:00am works. I'll send calendar invite once y'all confirm.

Diego: 10/14 3pm PT works for me. Thanks everyone for the speedy coordination.

Maria: Payroll note — final paycheck will be processed per regular cycle; any accrued PTO payout will be on the final statement. I'll include a COBRA cost estimate in the benefits packet so Diego can plan.

Ashwin: A couple of quick ops commands I'll run (internal):
```
# remove diego's public key from bastion authorized_keys
sudo sed -i '/diego@redwood.com/d' /etc/ssh/authorized_keys.d/*

# list service account keys for analytics-sa
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=analytics-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
I'll paste results to IT-4629 before making changes.

Ben: Reminder: rotate any API tokens he created in Vault and add owners for long-lived tokens. I'll audit and reassign by EOD 10/16.

Tammy: Rebecca — please confirm shipping preference in a DM with Diego and add UPS tracking to IT-4629 when done. Also I'll send exit interview invite and a short offboarding survey.

Rebecca: Will do. I'll also mark the laptop as "pending wipe" until we get it back, then wipe to corporate image and re-enroll.

Tammy: Thanks everyone — next steps: Maria sends COBRA packet on 2026-11-01, Ashwin executes deprovision steps on 10/16, Rebecca picks up and organizes asset return on 10/17, Ben handles DB/token rotations. I'll close out with Diego after the exit interview. :white_check_mark:
